affected_changes.description: Change records stranded by the LANE-1 outage inside the SLA windows.

affected_resource_or_operation.description: Immutable appointment, order, or resource record in the recovery scope.

business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

candidate_capacity.description: Gross candidate capacity associated with lane-hours on LANE-2 and LANE-3 between 2026-05-05 and 2026-05-08 before protected or unavailable load is removed.

capacity_gap.description: Uncovered LANE_HOUR after applying finite availability inside the requested window.

capacity_unit.description: Capacity unit used throughout the schedule comparison: LANE_HOUR.

changes_per_window.description: Remediation deploys the playbook allows in one 4-hour window.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Corvane's confirmed June image-baseline attestation dates on CQ-88420.

gate_results_required.description: GATE-INFRA-1 attestation runs the four stranded deploys read.

gate_results_usable.description: Usable attestation runs on hand after excluding the expiring set.

net_usable_capacity.description: Candidate capacity remaining after removing lane-hours already booked, held as protected freeze or compliance blocks, or blocked for maintenance.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing rehome_series_to_open_windows, wait_for_lane_1_return, displace_protected_freeze_window.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

required_capacity.description: lane-hours for four 2-hour remediation deploys (60 min rollout + 60 min attestation bake each)

selected_resource_or_control.description: Provider identifier of the qualified resource and session used by the selected recovery.

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Corvane's confirmed June image-baseline attestation dates on CQ-88420.

unavailable_or_protected_capacity.description: lane-hours already booked, held as protected freeze or compliance blocks, or blocked for maintenance

windows_required.description: Free windows the four deploys need when two are sequenced per window.

facts.rubric: Located CHG-70850 using immutable identifiers and preserved effective revision v1: the stranded change records are CHG-70850 to CHG-70853 for edge-proxy, queue-broker, dns-edge, and vpn-concentrator; the earliest is CHG-70850 (LKS-4510).
facts.statement: SHIP-0006: the stranded change records are CHG-70850 to CHG-70853 for edge-proxy, queue-broker, dns-edge, and vpn-concentrator; the earliest is CHG-70850 (LKS-4510); the effective revision is v1.

facts.rubric: Applied the effective issue, impact analysis, and playbook to establish 8 LANE_HOUR for lane-hours for four 2-hour remediation deploys (60 min rollout + 60 min attestation bake each), with control date 2026-05-12.
facts.statement: The effective issue, impact analysis, and playbook establish lane-hours for four 2-hour remediation deploys (60 min rollout + 60 min attestation bake each) = 8 LANE_HOUR: four 60 + 60 minute deploys need 8 lane-hours, or 2 windows when two deploys are sequenced per window. The control date is 2026-05-12 (latest acceptable date for the earliest pair (due 2026-05-05 + 7 days) under Pellworth's security addendum (COM-PEL-SEC-0512)).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 64 observed less 60 excluded to 4 supported LANE_HOUR for lane-hours on LANE-2 and LANE-3 between 2026-05-05 and 2026-05-08.
facts.statement: LANE-2 and LANE-3 offer 64 lane-hours this week in gross; 60 are booked, protected, or blocked, leaving one free window (4 h) on 2026-05-06, 4 hours short; eligibility requires netting the exclusions rather than trusting a header total.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-05-08 expedited readiness input for wait_for_lane_1_return, then separately derived its 2026-05-18 operating outcome under free regular windows on the attested lanes without displacing protected blocks instead of treating a partner promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Corvane's confirmed June image-baseline attestation dates on CQ-88420: Corvane CQ-88420 confirms the June baseline attestation standard 2026-05-13 and expedited 2026-05-07 (+USD 175); this week's deploys are covered by 6 usable 8810 runs; an external partner confirmation alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied free windows on LANE-2 and LANE-3, two deploys per window to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked windows.
facts.statement: free windows on LANE-2 and LANE-3, two deploys per window: the free windows are LANE-3 PM 2026-05-06 and LANE-2 AM 2026-05-11; LANE-1 returns 2026-05-15 with its first free window 2026-05-18; protected and blocked windows cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-RD-0106 only to rehome_series_to_open_windows and CHG-70850; kept displace_protected_freeze_window outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-RD-0106 authorizes free regular windows on LANE-2 and LANE-3 with two deploys per window; protected blocks need the change board and the maintenance window is off limits. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize displace_protected_freeze_window.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected rehome_series_to_open_windows: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies free regular windows on the attested lanes without displacing protected blocks.
facts.statement: the earliest pair must deploy by 2026-05-12 and the last by 2026-05-14, with USD 6,000 per day of slip under Pellworth's addendum; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside free regular windows on the attested lanes without displacing protected blocks.

options.consequence: rehome series to open windows pairs two deploys in LANE-3's free PM window on 2026-05-06 and the other two in LANE-2's free AM window on 2026-05-11, so the last deploy lands 2026-05-11, inside every SLA window, at no incremental cost.
options.label: rehome_series_to_open_windows: outcome 2026-05-11, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: wait for LANE-1 return uses its first free window on 2026-05-18 after the 2026-05-15 return to service; it costs nothing but lands 6 days after the control date and pushes every fleet past its 7-day window.
options.label: wait_for_lane_1_return: outcome 2026-05-18, incremental cost USD 0, FEASIBLE_WITH_INFERIOR_TRADEOFF

options.consequence: displace protected freeze window would finish all four by 2026-05-07 using LANE-2's protected AM block, 4 days earlier, but displacing a protected window needs the change advisory board, which AP-RD-0106 explicitly withholds.
options.label: displace_protected_freeze_window: outcome 2026-05-07, incremental cost USD 0, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED
